method: sand in the imagery over a hollow in the published 1 m laser DTM; the score is recovery of the 40 already-mapped bunkers, which never entered either rule

captures.captureLabel: Lantmäteriet Ortofoto 0.16 m, captured 2025-05-31, leaf-on (CC BY 4.0, Min karta)

sandWithoutHollow.why: the imagery is newer than the laser, so a bunker built between them has sand and no dish. Reported, never adopted: what would make the second record is the club's own dated statement that a bunker was built there.

rule.note: every colour threshold is measured on THIS capture and sits midway in the gap its own sand and turf pixels leave
